title: SBI Air India Platinum credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded Air India Platinum card offering accelerated Flying Returns miles, milestone flight vouchers, and travel perks for frequent domestic travelers.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Complimentary insurance cover worth 1 lakh against the loss of your card, applicable from 48 hours prior to 7 days after reporting the loss of your card to the bank.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Visit https://www.sbigeneral.in/claim to claim your insurance
